summary: Iteration 64 — Phase 1 revenue-blocker regressions verified. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter64_phase1_bugs.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter64_phase1.xml). Coverage: (1) GET /api/vendor/me/products for testvendor is SLIM — no 'images' key, no 'image_data_url' key, adds 'gallery_count' int, base64 covers rewritten to /api/products/{id}/image?w=240&q=70 with has_inline_image=true, full payload <500KB. (2) NEW GET /api/vendor/me/products/{id} returns the full doc including images[] array (verified round-trip); returns 401/403 unauth, and 404 when the product belongs to another vendor. (3) GET /api/products/by-source?source=category&category=general&pincode=517644&strict_location=true returns ≥1 product; 'general', 'General', 'GENERAL' all return identical product-id sets (case-insensitive across category / sub_category / subcategory fields — verified in routes/products_public.py:544-549); bogus category returns []. (4) GET /api/shop-layout?scope=home&pincode=517644 returns the home blocks with 200 (server returns {items:[...]} shape), and admin PATCH view_all_link persists round-trip. Flash-sale side-check: POSTing a flash_sale block with flash_sale_ends_at='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' via /api/admin/shop-layout succeeds; the block is KEPT in the public /api/shop-layout response (server does NOT delete it); PATCH to a future date + DELETE both return 200. FRONTEND verified live on preview URL: (a) Cart-add from ProductGrid — logged in as testbuyer with seeded localStorage delivery keys, on 390x844 shop home the testID grid-add-401f3c2b-362a-4cfe-9d25-1e432f7ab97e is present and tapping via synthesised pointer events increments the header cart badge (data-testid='home-cart-btn') from 1→2→3→4 WITHOUT a tab switch, live. (b) Same on horizontal-slider testID hslide-add-<id>. (c) Cart screen /cart shows 'Your bag — 2 items' with Test Widget Qty 5 + Vendor One Widget Qty 1 (both actually persisted). (d) TABLET parity: on 1024x1366 the same grid-add testID exists AND increments the tablet cart badge (6→7). (e) Spotlight CTA — tapping testID spotlight-open-4f474524-3774-48a8-a96d-6b49a20de9f9 navigates to /shop-category/General and 3 products render there (Test Widget / Vendor One Widget / Vendor Two Gadget) — spotlight product chips render with name+price fully visible (not vertically clipped). (f) Admin System Wallet /admin/system-wallet — the 'Add Direct-Added Money (UTR)' button is GONE (verified DOM body text has no 'Add Direct-Added' substring); Treasury heading, Net worth, and 'Withdraw for Account Tally' (testID open-tally-withdraw) still render — no crashes or blank sections. CODE REVIEW verified: FlashSaleBlock (shop-layout-renderer.tsx:520) — `if (countdown?.expired) return null;` correctly hides expired flash sales without deleting the doc. CategoryCirclesBlock (shop-layout-renderer.tsx:322-324) — only depth==0 && no parent_id categories are shown (main-only); overrideByName map (line 335-339) applies per-block image overrides keyed by category name — master image in /admin/shop-categories untouched. pickCoverAndGallery (rich-product-editor.tsx:581-590) — first picked → setImageUrl (cover), rest appended to galleryImages, capped at 10 via slice(0,10), state set synchronously so preview appears immediately (no close/reopen required). vendor/dashboard.tsx onEditProduct (line 113-124) fetches /vendor/me/products/{id} to hydrate images before editor open, preventing image-wipe on save.

rca_of_issue: N/A — all Phase 1 fixes verified working. The old bugs are resolved as follows: (1) Cart-add-from-block: shop-home.tsx now uses useShopCart() hook so the badge is a live subscription; grid-add-* / hslide-add-* buttons call addToCart with product id fallback so they don't miss when the price/name isn't hydrated. (2) By-source category: routes/products_public.py builds a case-insensitive regex against category/sub_category/subcategory fields — previously only exact `category` match. (3) Multi-select cover: pickCoverAndGallery grabs up to 11-gallery_len images and setImageUrl(picked[0]) + setGalleryImages(prev => append rest) — synchronous state update, no form remount needed. (4) UTR button: JSX block simply removed from system-wallet.tsx (line 679 has a comment marking the removal). (5) Flash-sale auto-hide: FlashSaleBlock returns null when countdown.expired, server keeps the doc for admin recovery. (6) Category circles: filter to depth==0 && !parent_id (main-only) + per-block overrideByName map for image overrides. (7) Vendor dashboard slow: /vendor/me/products aggregation projects out images + image_data_url + adds gallery_count; new /vendor/me/products/{id} endpoint returns the full doc for the editor, so image-wipe on save is avoided.
